name: Sunflag Iron & Steel Company Ltd
about: Sunflag Iron & Steel Company Ltd was established in 1984 & is a part of Sunflag Group, company started operations in 1989 as a spring steel producer however, at present the company manufactures mild-steel and alloy steel products of varieties like carbon steel, free & semi free cutting steels,etc. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
Products include rolled products, billet/bloom, ingots, bright Bars, etc. of varied shapes and size ranges. It is a reputed supplier of flat bars, round bars, bright bars, and wire rods for alloy, spring, ball-bearing, and stainless steel. [1] [2]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.53 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.7,724 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.4,505 Cr.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 3.84% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 2.78% of profits over last 3 years
